name: ro-housing
description: The harness of ro-housing: the house-style tools and the commands that run both projects. The app is api/ and web/, each with its own lockfile.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --prefix api && npm run typecheck --prefix web
scripts.lint: eslint . && npm run lint --prefix api && npm run lint --prefix web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix api && npm test --prefix web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:conventions && npm test
scripts.check:fast: npm run check:fast --prefix api && npm run check:fast --prefix web && node scripts/check-fast.mjs
scripts.check:conventions: npm run knip --prefix api && npm run knip --prefix web && depcruise api/src web/src && node vendor/house-style/bin/check-base-ui.mjs && node vendor/house-style/bin/check-structure.mjs
